-73.96050,40.77170.name: Manhattan Reproductive Medicine
-73.96050,40.77170.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Hanna Jesionowska, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-1.48622,53.35867.name: Care Fertility Sheffield
-1.48622,53.35867.state: 24-26, Glen Road, Sheffield, South Yorkshire, S7 1RA, United Kingdom
-1.48622,53.35867.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-73.71463,45.53291.desc: An institution certified by the Canadian Council on Animal Care for its use of animals in science. Certificate of GAP Last visit: interim, November 2024. CCAC certification is a condition of federal research funding rather than a licence, so an institution outside it is not necessarily outside the work — it may simply not take federal money. The CCAC publishes names and certificate status and no addresses, so this point marks the institution rather than the building where animals are held.

100.56000,13.73700.name: Charoen Pokphand Group
100.56000,13.73700.desc: A Thai conglomerate that is one of the largest animal feed and livestock producers in the world, operating across Asia. Feed buyers of this size decide what gets grown: an engineered soy or maize variety succeeds or fails on whether the companies feeding hundreds of millions of animals will purchase it.

8.30000,47.47000.name: Bejo / Rijk Zwaan seed testing and ISTA certification
8.30000,47.47000.desc: The International Seed Testing Association sets the methods by which a seed lot is declared pure, viable and free of unwanted material. Those methods decide what counts as contamination in a trade dispute, so a technical committee most people have never heard of is where the threshold between clean and not is actually set.

-0.19000,5.63000.name: Council for Scientific and Industrial Research — Ghana
-0.19000,5.63000.desc: Ghana’s public research council, which developed Bt cowpea alongside the Nigerian institute and holds the national crop collections. West African public research is where the crops poor farmers actually eat get worked on, and it operates on budgets a fraction of any company on this map.
